svg.title: Timing of the Matrix view's rain
svg.desc: A character's colour after a stream strikes it, the interval between released journal lines against the queue length, and the time a shower takes to decode a character.
svg.text: left: one information-level character after a strike; middle: lines released per second; right: time for a shower to reach a character
interval 0.5 s empty; 0.25 s at 3 queued
median 0.30 s; the last 1 percent by 0.69 s
Unstruck characters appear anyway UNVEIL = 3 s after their line is written, so no line stays hidden. The queue holds at most 2 x max(rows, 16) lines (76 at 38 rows).
